notes: This FDD covers two distinct outlet categories: 'Single Brand Outlets' and 'Co-Brand Outlets', each with their own Table 1 and Table 3. The yearly_summary array contains both sets (Single Brand rows first, then Co-Brand rows). The state_year_status array contains Single Brand Table 3 rows using standard state codes (AZ, CA, etc.) and Co-Brand Table 3 rows using '_COBRAND' suffix to distinguish them. Iowa Single Brand 2023 outlets_opened=2 includes a footnote that one franchisee converted from Co-Brand to single-brand A&W on May 1, 2023 (marked ** in source). Iowa Co-Brand 2023 ceased_other=1 corresponds to the same conversion event (marked * in source). Single Brand Table 3 Florida 2023 row shows outlets_start=1 — this appears to be a continuation row from the prior page where the state label is not repeated; context confirms it is Florida. The Co-Brand Table 1 Total Outlets 2024 shows end=214 while Franchised 2024 end=215 — this appears to be a source document discrepancy (214 vs 215); both values are transcribed as disclosed.
